import coverageData from '../data/coverage.json'

# SDK Test Coverage

The following table tracks the unit test code coverage across the `@thesolidchain` SDK workspace. We are aiming for **80% line coverage** on all business logic packages. 

*(Coverage is automatically generated from the `json-summary` vitest reporter)*

export const CoverageTable = () => {
  const packages = Object.keys(coverageData).filter(key => key !== 'Total').sort();
  const total = coverageData['Total'];

  const getEmoji = (pct) => {
    if (pct >= 80) return '✅';
    if (pct >= 50) return '⚠️';
    return '❌';
  };

  const getRowStyle = (key) => {
    if (key === 'Total') return { fontWeight: 'bold', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.05)' };
    return {};
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ marginTop: '2rem', overflowX: 'auto' }}>
      <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left' }}>
        <thead>
          <tr style={{ borderBottom: '2px solid #eaeaea' }}>
            <th style={{ padding: '12px' }}>Package</th>
            <th style={{ padding: '12px' }}>Statements</th>
            <th style={{ padding: '12px' }}>Branches</th>
            <th style={{ padding: '12px' }}>Functions</th>
            <th style={{ padding: '12px' }}>Lines</th>
            <th style={{ padding: '12px' }}>Status</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {packages.map(pkg => (
            <tr key={pkg} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #eaeaea' }}>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px', fontWeight: '500' }}><code>{pkg}</code></td>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px' }}>{coverageData[pkg].statements.pct}%</td>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px' }}>{coverageData[pkg].branches.pct}%</td>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px' }}>{coverageData[pkg].functions.pct}%</td>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>{coverageData[pkg].lines.pct}%</td>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px' }}>{getEmoji(parseFloat(coverageData[pkg].lines.pct))}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
          {total && (
            <tr style={getRowStyle('Total')}>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px' }}>Total (Aggregated)</td>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px' }}>{total.statements.pct}%</td>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px' }}>{total.branches.pct}%</td>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px' }}>{total.functions.pct}%</td>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>{total.lines.pct}%</td>
              <td style={{ padding: '12px' }}>{getEmoji(parseFloat(total.lines.pct))}</td>
            </tr>
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
};

<CoverageTable />
